title: angelica veneta
intro: Angelica veneta, commonly known as Angelica, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Apiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as relief from digestive issues, reduction in inflammation, and support for the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Angelica veneta include its antispasmodic, diuretic, and expectorant properties, which help in alleviating symptoms of coughs, colds, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Angelica veneta include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
